_: Offline imagery packs: the satellite layer's redistributable stand-in, one archive per entry, built by build-imagery-pack.mjs and listed in the app's Offline regions beside the region packs. Which layer and how deep come from the catalog (LayerMeta.offlinePack); what the archive covers is the source's own footprint inside `bbox` — the builder only descends into ground the source actually draws, so the box is a limit, not a promise.

packs.name: Satellite imagery · Norway
packs._bbox: Mainland Norway with sea to spare. Kartverket's Sentinel-2 mosaic stops at the border and some kilometres offshore, and does not cover Svalbard or Jan Mayen at all (probed 2026-09-18: transparent there), so this box does not try to reach them.
packs._smoke: Points that must have a real tile at the deepest zoom: the south, the middle, and the far north-east, so a build that stopped early or lost a whole sheet of the mosaic cannot publish.
